               <lb n="N004"/>pa ni nges 'byed pa na lag dang mthong ba'i zhes pa'i skabs su bstan pa ltar sgom lam gyi yul da nges 'byad yan lag gam mchod snog lta bu'i don gcig tu sbyor zhes paso ||</seg></TEI>
